The facilities parameter can be one of "Wi-Fi" | "Reading Room" | "Fiction" | "Children Section" | "Cafe"[].

We need to call the function three times, each with location and facilities. For New York: location "New York, NY", facilities: "Reading Room" | "Fiction". But likely we need to pass an array? The description: "Facilities and sections in public library." It might accept an array of strings. But the type says "Cafe"[] meaning array of "Cafe"? Actually "Cafe"[] means array of string "Cafe"? That seems weird. But maybe they want to pass an array of facilities. Let's assume we pass an array of strings: ["Reading Room", "Fiction"].

Similarly for Los Angeles: ["Wi-Fi", "Children Section"]. For Chicago: ["Cafe", "Reading Room"].
